solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Measure of health variable after two groups dine out

indicators.note: after places the variable at the end, following the groups and the rearranged dine

parts.note: a body and a mass are both groups or collections of people

indicators.note: out signals that the letters of dine are put out of order

parts.note: X is the classic algebraic variable

explanation.surface: A health statistic that shifts once two parties go out to eat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' is the anagram signal on dine; 'after' puts the variable X last, even though it comes first in the clue.
explanation.definitionFit: The body mass index is a standard figure doctors use to judge whether weight is healthy.

clue.text: With case in beige, packs ornaments

indicators.note: the case of a word is its outside, so the first and last letters of beige are taken

parts.note: packs of cards are decks

explanation.surface: A beige box holding decorative trinkets packed together.
explanation.walkthrough: 'case in' takes the outside letters of beige, BE.
explanation.definitionFit: To ornament something is to decorate or adorn it, which is what bedecking means.

clue.text: Released journalist after hated superior's upset

indicators.note: after puts the journalist below the reversed word
in a down clue the word on top, the superior one, is turned upside down, read backwards

parts.note: to revile someone is to abuse them out of hatred, so hated gives reviled
ED, short for editor, is the crossword's standard journalist

explanation.surface: A reporter freed once a despised boss has been overthrown.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down light the superior word is the upper one; 'upset' turns it upside down, so the reversal sits above the editor.
explanation.definitionFit: To deliver someone is to set them free, so delivered is a synonym of released.

clue.text: Arachnid's pronounced power

indicators.note: pronounced means the word is spoken and another word heard

parts.note: a mite is a tiny arachnid, kin to spiders and ticks

explanation.surface: A spider's famous strength.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's reads as 'is', a link between the wordplay and the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Might is strength or force, a straightforward synonym of power.

clue.text: Duck that is found among sheep regularly

indicators.note: found among puts the Latin phrase inside the other letters
regularly takes every other letter of sheep, starting with the first

parts.note: id est is the Latin for that is, abbreviated i.e.

explanation.surface: A bird spotted wandering through a flock of sheep.
explanation.walkthrough: 'regularly' takes S, E, P from sheep; 'found among' sets ID EST between S and EP.
explanation.definitionFit: To duck an issue is to dodge or evade it, which is what sidestepping means.

clue.text: Offensive action in American uprising supported by officer

indicators.note: supported by puts the officer underneath in a down light
uprising in a down clue means the letters are read from the bottom up

parts.note: US stands for United States, hence American
Lt is the abbreviation for lieutenant

explanation.surface: A US revolt propped up by a military officer is an act of aggression.
explanation.definitionFit: An insult is an offensive remark or deed, an affront aimed at someone.

clue.text: Engineer used bolts with certainty

indicators.note: to engineer something is to construct or contrive it, so these letters are rebuilt

explanation.surface: A mechanic confidently fastened things with bolts.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Engineer' looks like the subject of the sentence but is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Doubtless is an adverb meaning certainly, without any doubt.

clue.text: Gas cattle's beginning to release concerning

indicators.note: the beginning of the word is let go, so its first letter is dropped

parts.note: oxen are cattle
on means about or concerning, as in a talk on art

explanation.surface: Herd animals start to give off gas.
explanation.walkthrough: 'beginning to release' drops the O of OXEN, leaving XEN.
explanation.definitionFit: Xenon is one of the noble gases, used in some lamps.

clue.text: Call about provider of wi-fi that's fragile

indicators.note: about means the call goes around the provider

parts.note: to cry out is to call
an ISP is an internet service provider

explanation.surface: A complaint about a wi-fi company with a weak connection.
explanation.definitionFit: Crispy food is brittle and snaps easily, so it is fragile.

clue.text: Overwhelmed bear caught in act

indicators.note: caught in means one word is held inside the other

parts.note: a deed is an act
to lug is to carry or bear something heavy

explanation.surface: Someone swamped after a bear was trapped mid-performance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bear' is the animal in the surface but the verb carry in the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: Deluged means flooded or swamped, as with work or letters.

clue.text: Beauty queen following new fans around

indicators.note: following places the queen after the other pieces
around turns the word for fans back to front

parts.note: nuts are enthusiasts, as in football nuts
ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the crossword queen

explanation.surface: A beauty queen with admirers crowding round her.
explanation.walkthrough: 'around' is the reversal signal on the word for fans, not a sign of one piece going round another.
explanation.definitionFit: A stunner is a strikingly attractive person, a beauty.

clue.text: Yearn for having Romeo to disappear in secret

indicators.note: to disappear means the letter is taken out

parts.note: covert means hidden or secret
Romeo is R in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: Pining for a lover called Romeo who vanished in secret.
explanation.definitionFit: To covet is to desire eagerly, especially what belongs to another.

clue.text: Condition of locks and spindles poor, needing time invested

indicators.note: invested means the time is put inside, as money is put into something
poor signals that the letters of spindles are in bad order

explanation.surface: Faulty spindles on a door lock need time spent on them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'poor' rearranges SPINDLES to SPLIENDS; 'invested' puts T in.
explanation.definitionFit: Split ends are frayed hair tips, a problem of locks in the sense of tresses.

clue.text: Afflicted when arm receives sprain

indicators.note: receives means the gun takes the sprain inside it

parts.note: the Sten was a British submachine gun, a firearm
a rick is a sprain or wrench

explanation.surface: Someone suffering because their arm has been twisted.
explanation.definitionFit: Stricken means struck down or badly affected, as by illness or grief.

clue.text: Very tough seeing awkward truth in film

indicators.note: in puts the rearranged letters inside the film

parts.note: a coat is a thin layer or film, as of paint

indicators.note: awkward means the letters of truth are clumsily arranged

explanation.surface: Finding an uncomfortable truth in a movie very hard going.
explanation.walkthrough: 'film' is not a movie but a coating; 'awkward' turns TRUTH into UTTHR.
explanation.definitionFit: Cutthroat describes fierce, ruthless rivalry, as in cutthroat competition.

clue.text: Check of way fire vehicle reversed

indicators.note: reversed says the hidden letters are read backwards
of signals that the answer is made of letters drawn from the following words

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Inspecting a fire engine on the road.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft left 'of' as a link, but it is what signals the hidden letters; 'reversed' then reads YFIREV backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: To verify is to confirm or check that something is true.

clue.text: Direct one on sea current to harbour in China

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

indicators.note: to harbour is to shelter, so the friend holds the other letters inside

parts.note: china is rhyming slang for mate, from china plate
the Med is the Mediterranean Sea
I is the symbol for electric current

explanation.surface: Steering someone at sea with the tide into a Chinese port.
explanation.walkthrough: China plate is Cockney rhyming slang for mate (friend); MATE holds MEDI to give MMEDIATE.
explanation.definitionFit: Immediate contact is direct, with nothing between, so the adjectives match.

clue.text: Supports best player on field

parts.note: to back someone is to support them
top means best, as in the top student

explanation.surface: Fans cheering the star of the team.
explanation.definitionFit: In baseball the backstop is the catcher, a fielder who stops balls behind the batter.

clue.text: Modernise university with adept redeveloping

indicators.note: redeveloping means the letters of adept are rebuilt in another order

explanation.surface: Bringing a campus up to date with skilled rebuilding.
explanation.definitionFit: To update something is to bring it up to date, making it modern.

clue.text: Impertinent lump oddly lacking shame

indicators.note: lacking the odd letters means only the second and fourth letters of lump are kept

parts.note: a pity is a shame, as in what a shame

explanation.surface: A rude oaf with no sense of shame.
explanation.definitionFit: Uppity means arrogant or presumptuous, behaving above one's station.

clue.text: Have to, when retired, like fruit

indicators.note: retired means drawn back, so the letters are read in reverse

parts.note: must means have to
as can mean when, as in as I left
as means like, as in do as I do

explanation.surface: Something one must do upon retiring, like eating fruit.
explanation.definitionFit: Satsumas are small loose-skinned citrus fruits, a kind of mandarin.

clue.text: Browse internet sites on upcoming band in excess

parts.note: to surf is to browse websites

indicators.note: upcoming in a down clue means the letters rise, read from the bottom

parts.note: a tie is a band or bond

explanation.surface: Spending too much time online looking up a forthcoming group.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upcoming' turns TIE to EIT; 'band' is a strip, not a music group.
explanation.definitionFit: A surfeit is an excess or overabundance of something.

clue.text: Rather old individual covered by "senior"

indicators.note: covered by means the senior abbreviation wraps around the other letters

parts.note: one means a single individual

explanation.surface: An aged person cared for by a so-called senior.
explanation.definitionFit: Sooner can mean rather, as in I would sooner stay home.

clue.text: Skewering meat, desire fine spiked tool

indicators.note: skewering means piercing, so the other letters run through the meat

parts.note: pork is a meat
an itch is a restless desire
F is the pencil-grade abbreviation for fine

explanation.surface: Wanting to spear meat with a pronged implement.
explanation.definitionFit: A pitchfork is a long-handled farm fork with sharp prongs for lifting hay.

clue.text: Heartless crew turned on fellow criminal

indicators.note: turned means the remaining letters are read backwards
heartless means the central letter is removed

parts.note: an eight is a rowing crew

explanation.surface: A cruel gang betrayed one of their own.
explanation.walkthrough: An eight is a rowing crew; 'Heartless' drops G to give EIHT, and 'turned' makes THIE.
explanation.definitionFit: A thief is a criminal who steals.

clue.text: Lords were ignoring all characters outside rank

indicators.note: dropping the outside letters of each word keeps only their insides

explanation.surface: Peers once paid no attention to anyone outside their class.
explanation.definitionFit: An order is a social class or rank, as in the lower orders.

clue.text: Urn perhaps not second-rate vessel

indicators.note: not means the letter is left out

parts.note: a tea urn is one kind of boiler
B is a second-rate grade

explanation.surface: A tea urn that is not a cheap container.
explanation.definitionFit: An oiler is a ship that carries oil, a tanker.

clue.text: Fool shortly joining soldiers with knight's headwear

indicators.note: shortly means the word is cut short by its last letter

parts.note: to fool someone is to trick them
OR, other ranks, means ordinary soldiers
N is the chess notation for knight

explanation.surface: A jester hurrying to join the troops, wearing a knight's helmet.
explanation.definitionFit: A tricorn is a three-cornered hat of the eighteenth century.

clue.text: Farmer's preparation suffering after start of the season

indicators.note: after puts the suffering behind the opening letter
the start of a word is its first letter

parts.note: ill means sick, suffering
an age is a period of time, a season

explanation.surface: A farmer falling ill just as the season begins.
explanation.definitionFit: Tillage is the ploughing and working of land before planting crops.

clue.text: Approaching model makes you tense

parts.note: future means yet to come, approaching
a model pupil is a perfect one

explanation.surface: A coming catwalk star leaves you nervous.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tense' looks like nervous, but it is the grammar term.
explanation.definitionFit: The future perfect is a verb tense, as in will have gone.
